name: Jiangsu Aisen Semiconductor Material Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Aisen Semiconductor Material Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of electronic chemicals in China and internationally. The company offers positive and negative photoresist, developer, Cu etchant GCT ECU 312, positive and negative stripper GCT STN 1900, and AL cleaner GCT AC 6680 for wafer/advanced packaging applications; and OLED positive photoresist, stripper, and Ag etchant for TFT-LCD/AMOLED applications.
